Minimum Qualifications Include:  
 Education: B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent experience in a work related field/discipline 
 Experience: Minimum of sex (6) years of experience with JAVA, J2EE, ORM and Databases 
 Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 
 These are the observable and measurable attributes and skills required to perform successfully the essential functions of the job and are generally demonstrated through qualifying experience, education, or licensure/certification. 
 Knowledge of cloud-based hosting services and external hosting partners 
 Knowledge of disciplined software release build/deploy processes 
 Knowledge of best practices for implementation of multi-language / international applications 
 Knowledge of MySQL, Apache, Hibernate, AJAX, JavaScript, MongoDB 
 Ability to design, implement, deploy, and ship high-volume and scalable software 
 Ability to create and maintain build and unit test systems 
 Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization 
 Ability to demonstrate analytical and problem solving skills 
 Ability to work on multiple overlapping projects 
 Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  JAVA, J2EE, ORM and Databases
